<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bbox(f):
    L = f.ascii.split('\n')
    pur = [(i,j) for i in range(15,45) for j in range(64) if L[i][j]=='p' and i<34]
    if not pur: return None
    return (min(p[0] for p in pur), max(p[0] for p in pur), min(p[1] for p in pur), max(p[1] for p in pur))
# currently at 45deg default
print("start:", bbox(current_frame))
for k in range(4):
    action(['DOWN'])
    print("DOWN", k+1, bbox(current_frame))
for k in range(6):
    action(['UP'])
    print("UP", k+1, bbox(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
